name: LibriSpeech ASR Corpus
description: LibriSpeech is a corpus of approximately 1,000 hours of 16kHz read English speech derived from read audiobooks from the LibriVox project. Prepared by Vassil Panayotov with assistance from Daniel Povey, it features carefully segmented and aligned acoustic audio and normalized text transcripts, divided into clean and other subsets.

citation.paper_title: Librispeech: An ASR corpus based on public domain audio books

provenance.collection_method: Extracted from LibriVox public domain audio recordings and aligned to Project Gutenberg texts using Kaldi speech recognition toolkit.
provenance.curation_notes: Audio files filtered based on acoustic model score alignments and split into clean and noisy/accented subsets.
